newsitem.title: USA: Jack Henry Sept 30 backlog rises 86 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jack Henry Sept 30 backlog rises 86 pct.

text.p: Jack Henry & Associates Inc, which provides computer systems and ATM networking products for banks and other financial institutions, said Wednesday its backlog of sales at September 30, 1996 totaled $16.5 million, up 86 percent over last year's level.

Earlier today, Jack Henry reported earnings for its fiscal 1997 first quarter ended September 30, 1996 rose to $3.8 million or $0.30 a share on revenues of $18.4 million from $3.1 million or $0.25 and revenues of $16.2 million last year.
First quarter results continue to reflect strong sales of the company's software systems and growth in maintenance support and service revenues, Jack Henry said in a statement.
